notes.title: Battle Train is rolling into the station with an explosive new update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066558/187989c741174fd852ea81a2d3b2e0a23e9fff4d.jpg"]

Hi all! 



We’re super excited to tell you all about the giant mega update coming to Battle Train on September 4th.  It’s basically two updates in one, both with substantial new stuff, along with a couple fixes to some bugs reported by the community (thank you!)



First, we’ve got ENDLESS MODE!!!  Endless Mode is just what it sounds like: as long as you survive, you can keep crushing your enemies.  Here’s what you’ll be seeing in game:



A new submenu for the “play” button, to keep the main menu nice and uncluttered

The Endless Overworld, balanced to make opponents more difficult as you hit each subsequent map

Additional map boards for minigames, to keep things from getting repetitive for those super long survival runs

An Endless Mode Leaderboard, because honestly, it’s all about bragging rights, isn’t it?



As for bug fixes, we’ve addressed the following:



Your display name should now fit on the leaderboard

Each train part slot should now only have ONE part assigned to it for the daily run

Your incredibly long, high damage locomotives should be able to finish hitting your target without   timing out now, which was causing catastrophic mayhem (to turn progression, as well as to the   enemy outpost).

Run durations should now properly reset, which was previously leading to a series of issues.

Cards should show consistently as the correct type

And some translation corrections



Then, as if that wasn’t enough, we are also releasing our first DLC, Revenge of the Puffin!  Do you love the Battle Train story?  Do you want… more?  How about more opponents, more puzzles, and more maps?  Well, friend, we have got you covered!  Revenge of the Puffin includes:



A new chapter of the Battle Train story

A new custom Overworld, where player progression is saved, and players can take multiple runs at challenging bosses or puzzle levels.

A new champion and new grunts

New cards, trains, stickers, and hats!

New custom maps, designed to provoke your problem solving skills

New custom Explodathon puzzles

A new Snowy Environment



Frankly, we cannot wait to see how you all like it.  We think it’s pretty darn neat.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066558/ab40d5f8edc0e4cc2322e75941898c9df394a1cd.png"]Battle Train Endless Mode Update and Revenge of the Puffin DLC will be available on Steam on September 4th, and Switch on September 5th.

notes.title: We’ve got a Hotfix for you!!!
notes.content:
Hello, Battle Train players! 



First and foremost, we’d like to thank every single one of you who has played Battle Train and reached out to us with your feedback. Your positive comments mean the world to us, and your constructive criticism helps us make the game better!



On that second point, we’ve got some updates we think you’ll be excited to see.



●       We’ve updated the way we are tracking Door of Worthiness progress, as well as the frequency of story nodes, to address feedback from you all–progression should be much, much faster and players shouldn’t feel as penalized for not choosing story paths now, which helps with some (although not all) of the story-gate feedback we’ve received

●       You can now rebind the keyboard’s directional keys for camera movement/card selection

●       We’ve made it more obvious when the player has a connected route and can attack, so that players are less likely to accidentally end their turn without attacking

●       You can now view the enemy exhaust/discard pile.

●       Battle cards are now smaller on handheld devices, allowing more of the map to be visible

●       We fixed the AI getting stuck for a long time when trying to place a Deployable type of object

●       We removed a hidden mana cost penalty for the AI playing the first card in a turn

●       The hat shop will no longer spawn in segment 1 of a run, since no one ever has enough gold to buy anything at that point.

●       The “impossible-without-bombs” card rush maps have been edited to… well… not be impossible…

●       Some Trinket Route modifier issues should be resolved, allowing them to correctly apply every time.

●       Smoke Bomb card effect reduced to 1 turn

●       AI no longer has access to barricade track cards

●       AI no longer has access to the Build-A-Mine card, which was causing softlock issues

●       Trinkets that give a healing buff on win should now have a visible effect

●       Trinkets that give a random chance for extra mana have had their seed fixed.

●       Edited the icon for the Power of Love buff

●       For our Steam Deck players - external controllers on the Steam Deck should now properly handle secondary controller inputs



Thank you again for being part of the Battle Train Community. We’re continuing to add to the game and are happy to see such enthusiastic players! If you’d like to chat with others about Battle Train or be able to talk things over with the Devs directly, feel free to join us on Discord! 

http://discord.terribleposture.com/





The TPG Crew

notes.title: A Very TPG Thanksgiving
notes.content:
For those of us in the US, Thanksgiving is right around the corner.  While every year has its ups and downs, here are some of the things we here at Terrible Posture are grateful for:


 Our Kickstarter was backed at 213%.  That’s not too shabby, and we’re grateful to everyone who believed in the game enough to support us there.
 Battle Train was also included in several top demo lists that came out during Steam Next Fest.  In a field that had over 3,000 demos to try we’re grateful to have stood out among the crowd.
 We’re grateful for the continued feedback from players who really seem to love the game.  Your enthusiasm is awesome, and we appreciate it so much.


If you haven’t played the SUPER DEMO yet, it’s still available here on Steam!  If you give it a try, let us know what you think.

For everyone waiting on the full game, the release date is still expected to be in early 2025, so stay tuned!

Thank you all for being a part of the Terrible Posture Community.  
The TPG Dev Team

notes.title: Battle Train Super Demo, and Kickstarter honors game with "Projects We Love" award!
notes.content:
https://clan.steamstatic.com/images/33210920/1789ce6c168a9437d4183f00c367e41fb51f2690.jpg
Makers of Tower of Guns and Mothergunship's New Game
Did you know Terrible Posture Games has a new project about dueling with exploding trains? 

We've teamed up with Nerd Ninjas to bring you BATTLE TRAIN. 

Lay your tracks out to the enemy base, wrestle control of resources from the enemy, build your train into the ultimate demolition machine, and then launch pure destruction upon your foe!

But don't just take our word for it. 
We're excited to be participating in Steam ːtogcakeːNext Fest, and we have a new SUPER demo out now! It's too big to be called a regular demo and you can give it a try (and wishlist the game) right  HERE! We'd love to know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708950/Battle_Train/

https://clan.steamstatic.com/images/33210920/31d1026d8b737a35128b84aca6faf925b3e2b135.png

Final Week on Kickstarter
That's not all though; we're -also- running our first Kickstarter for the game, fundraising to push an already great game to new levels and build all sorts of wacky ideas we really want to stretch for; cat trains, electric maniac champions, terrible poetry.. we need your help to get all these final extra awesome details into the game. 

We love Battle Train, and Kickstarter seems to agree; they just awarded us with an official "Projects We Love" badge! We're humbled and thrilled. We're in our final week of fund raising for the project--so now is the time to act!

Back us on Kickstarter  HERE!
